name: project-coding-profiles
description: Per-project coding profiles: declare a single project's encoding policy (GBK/UTF-8), overall coding mode, and interface scaffolding, enforced via skills + hooks scoped to that project. Complements team-standards (the team-wide standard). First profile: Yoooni (src=GBK / WebRoot=UTF-8 mixed encoding).

interface.shortDescription: Per-project encoding, code location, and module scaffolding conventions.
interface.longDescription: Carries coding profiles scoped to individual projects. It protects legacy file encodings, locates frontend and backend code from URLs, and scaffolds new modules from project-specific reference slices. Works across Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, with hooks providing deterministic encoding and frontend-control guards where supported.
